messages.author: 6a4fb43d9bde6289
messages.subject: suggestions
parts:
Hello,
I am fairly new to Nimble and usually use Stan for Bayesian analysis.
I am glad that Nimble team will support Tensorflow backend and variational inference features.
Just to hope Nimble's future popularity, 

1. More examples.
I agree that there are various Bugs examples, but it may be useful to provide various application examples.
Current examples focused on better MCMC samplers. But sometimes, many people are looking for Bayesian modeling software for application purposes. Thus, various application examples will be very useful..
I think one of the biggest fascinating points of Stan and PyMC3 is various application examples, so many newbies can be accustomed to the new software without lots of efforts.

https://github.com/stan-dev/example-models/wiki
https://pymc-devs.github.io/pymc3/examples.html#


2. Discourse group 
I found that many software provides discourse discussion sites. I think google group is ok, but discourse looks more convenient for equations, markdown, and codes, etc.. 

https://discourse.edwardlib.org
http://discourse.mc-stan.org/

I hope you don't mind my suggestions. I love R and hope Nimble will be more popular in the future!
Thanks

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: suggestions
parts:
Thank you for these suggestions.  We welcome them.

If anyone else on the list has general feedback or suggestions for the development team, please share them with us either via this list, or to just the development team at nimble...@gmail.com, or to me directly.  We are working on lots of features, including improved user experience and improved web-site content, but it is very helpful to us to hear from folks trying or using the software about what would be most important to you so we can adjust priorities accordingly.

Perry
